findings.summary: On the original Tallis-Read test set, Marrowfield-ASR achieves a lower WER (5.8%) than both Ostrander-CTC (6.4%) and Pellucid-RNNT (6.1%), but no statistical test is reported, so the difference is not established as significant.
findings.scope: Tallis-Read test set, original recordings, WER (%), mean over 3 seeds
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences may not be reliable.

findings.summary: The research question about robustness to additive background noise cannot be answered from the supplied evidence, because no noise conditions were evaluated and no robustness criterion was applied.
findings.caveats: Only original recordings were tested; no noise-added conditions or robustness comparisons are present.

sentences.text: On the original Tallis-Read test set, Marrowfield-ASR achieved a lower word error rate (5.8%) than both Ostrander-CTC (6.4%) and Pellucid-RNNT (6.1%), though no statistical tests were reported for these comparisons.

The research question regarding robustness to additive background noise cannot be answered from the supplied evidence, as only original recordings were evaluated and no noise-added conditions or robustness criterion were applied.
